name: Snowpipe and Snowpipe Streaming
sku: Snowpipe and Snowpipe Streaming, available in Snowflake Standard edition.

ingest.batch-extract.note: Snowpipe loads files from a stage as soon as they arrive, in a serverless way, triggered by cloud storage event notifications or a REST call. It loads files only; it does not extract from databases or SaaS applications.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Snowpipe Streaming writes rows straight into tables from applications, the Kafka connector or SDKs, quoting as low as 5 seconds from ingest to queryable. Named channels give ordered, exactly-once ingestion.

presentation.tagline: Serverless file loading and low-latency row streaming into Snowflake tables.
